sections.text: Media studies analyzes how media forms, industries, and texts shape culture, power, and human perception. The field sits at the intersection of sociology, political economy, semiotics, and philosophy of technology. It oscillates between two poles: critical theory (media as ideological apparatus) and empirical audience research (media effects on actual people).
